# Generated builds

Install **one** variant; both register `core.retinex_gpu` and include exact, fast and fastest modes.

| File | Includes |
|---|---|
| `retinex_gpu.dll` | All-in-one: CPU + NVIDIA CUDA |
| `cpu-only/retinex_gpu.dll` | CPU only; no NVIDIA dependency |
| `releases/retinex-2.1-all-in-one-windows-x64.zip` | One all-in-one DLL, source, licenses and docs |
| `releases/retinex-2.1-cpu-only-windows-x64.zip` | One CPU-only DLL, source, licenses and docs |
| `releases/SHA256SUMS.txt`, `releases/release-build-info.json` | Checksums and build/source metadata |

These outputs are ignored by Git. [Build and package](../docs/building.md).
